records.qa_original_reason: put away clutter虽能理解，但clear away clutter或put away scattered items更自然；新版例句已换目标表达，需Master批准canonical目标及Sense身份。

author_candidate_answer_only.example_zh: 开始工作前，把桌上散乱的物品收起来。

records.editorial_reason_or_constraint: If source intent instead stresses removal of mess, clear away clutter is a distinct natural candidate; Master chooses one canonical action.

records.qa_original_reason: shrunken clothes、clothes that have shrunk比作前置修饰语的shrunk clothes通常更自然；作者例句已避开原目标，需要Master裁定规范表达。

author_candidate_answer_only.example_zh: 这些缩水的衣服我已经穿不下了。

records.editorial_reason_or_constraint: Clothes that have shrunk is a natural paraphrase; do not silently treat the source past-participle form shrunk clothes as a certified head expression.

records.qa_original_reason: color bleed与color bleeding在衣物掉色语境可能同一教学目标；新例句使用后者，需Master做同场景去重及目标词形裁决。

records.editorial_reason_or_constraint: Color bleed is also used as a noun in specialist laundry/fabric contexts; a natural example alone cannot justify changing the canonical name. Check other same-scene items.

author_candidate_answer_only.example_en: There was a white residue on the glasses after the dishwasher cycle.

records.qa_original_reason: water overflow可作技术名词，但The water overflow damaged...日常英语较生硬；可用An overflow of water damaged...或Overflowing water damaged...；目标词性及场景由Master确定。

author_candidate_answer_only.example_en: The sensor detected a water overflow near the sink.

records.editorial_reason_or_constraint: The noun phrase is usable in technical alerts; for everyday prose use Water overflowed from the sink or An overflow of water damaged the cabinet. Do not replace noun Sense with verb Sense automatically.
